install.title: Install LapWing
install.body: Works offline at the track — no signal needed.
install.iosWhy: On iPhone and iPad, Safari deletes an uninstalled site’s offline data after about a week. Adding LapWing to your Home Screen keeps it — and your saved sessions — between race weekends.
install.iosStepShare: Tap Share in the Safari toolbar
install.iosStepOpen: Then open LapWing from the new icon once while you still have signal, so it can save itself for offline use.
